verses.original: δὲ πέντε ἡμέρας Μετὰ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς Ἁνανίας κατέβη μετὰ τινῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ τινός ῥήτορος Τερτύλλου οἵτινες ἐνεφάνισαν τῷ ἡγεμόνι κατὰ τοῦ Παύλου
verses.transliteration: de pente hēmeras Meta ho archiereus Hananias katebē meta tinōn presbyterōn kai tinos rhētoros Tertyllou hoitines enephanisan tō hēgemoni kata tou Paulou
verses.literal: - Five days later the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a lawyer [named] Tertullus who presented to the governor {their case} against - Paul

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Κληθέντος ὁ Τέρτυλλος ἤρξατο κατηγορεῖν λέγων διὰ σοῦ τυγχάνοντες Πολλῆς εἰρήνης καὶ διὰ τῆς σῆς προνοίας γινομένων διορθωμάτων τούτῳ τῷ ἔθνει
verses.transliteration: de autou Klēthentos ho Tertyllos ērxato katēgorein legōn dia sou tynchanontes Pollēs eirēnēs kai dia tēs sēs pronoias ginomenōn diorthōmatōn toutō tō ethnei
verses.literal: [When] [Paul] had been called in - Tertullus opened the prosecution - Because of you we have enjoyed a lasting peace and - - your foresight has brought improvements to this - nation

verses.original: τε πάντῃ καὶ πανταχοῦ κράτιστε Φῆλιξ ἀποδεχόμεθα μετὰ πάσης εὐχαριστίας
verses.transliteration: te pantē kai pantachou kratiste Phēlix apodechometha meta pasēs eucharistias
verses.literal: - In every way and everywhere most excellent Felix we acknowledge [this] with all gratitude

verses.original: δὲ ἵνα μὴ ἐνκόπτω σε ἐπὶ πλεῖόν παρακαλῶ σε τῇ σῇ ἐπιεικείᾳ ἀκοῦσαί ἡμῶν συντόμως
verses.transliteration: de hina mē enkoptō se epi pleion parakalō se tē sē epieikeia akousai hēmōn syntomōs
verses.literal: But in order not to delay you - any further I beg - - your indulgence to hear us briefly

verses.original: γὰρ Εὑρόντες τοῦτον τὸν ἄνδρα λοιμὸν καὶ κινοῦντα στάσεις πᾶσιν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις τοῖς κατὰ τὴν οἰκουμένην τε πρωτοστάτην τῆς αἱρέσεως τῶν Ναζωραίων
verses.transliteration: gar Heurontes touton ton andra loimon kai kinounta staseis pasin tois Ioudaiois tois kata tēn oikoumenēn te prōtostatēn tēs haireseōs tōn Nazōraiōn
verses.literal: - We have found this - man [to be] a pestilence - stirring up dissension among the Jews - all over the world [He is] a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes

verses.original: ὃς καὶ ἐπείρασεν βεβηλῶσαι τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐκρατήσαμεν ὃν
verses.transliteration: hos kai epeirasen bebēlōsai to hieron kai ekratēsamen hon
verses.literal: [and he] even tried to desecrate the temple [so] we seized [him]

verses.original: ἀνακρίνας παρ’ οὗ αὐτὸς δυνήσῃ ἐπιγνῶναι περὶ πάντων τούτων ὧν ἡμεῖς κατηγοροῦμεν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: anakrinas par’ hou autos dynēsē epignōnai peri pantōn toutōn hōn hēmeis katēgoroumen autou
verses.literal: By examining - him yourself you will be able to learn [the truth] about all . . . - our charges [against] him

verses.original: δὲ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ Συνεπέθεντο φάσκοντες ταῦτα ἔχειν οὕτως
verses.transliteration: de hoi Ioudaioi kai Synepethento phaskontes tauta echein houtōs
verses.literal: - The Jews vvv concurred asserting that these [charges] were true

verses.original: τε τοῦ ἡγεμόνος νεύσαντος αὐτῷ λέγειν ὁ Παῦλος Ἀπεκρίθη ἐπιστάμενος σε ὄντα κριτὴν τῷ τούτῳ ἔθνει Ἐκ πολλῶν ἐτῶν ἀπολογοῦμαι εὐθύμως τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: te tou hēgemonos neusantos autō legein ho Paulos Apekrithē epistamenos se onta kritēn tō toutō ethnei Ek pollōn etōn apologoumai euthymōs ta peri emautou
verses.literal: [When] the governor motioned for [Paul] to speak - [he] began his response Knowing that you have been a judge over this nation for many years I gladly make my defense . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: σου δυναμένου ἐπιγνῶναι ὅτι οὐ εἰσίν μοι πλείους δώδεκα ἡμέραι ἀφ’ ἧς ἀνέβην εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ προσκυνήσων
verses.transliteration: sou dynamenou epignōnai hoti ou eisin moi pleious dōdeka hēmerai aph’ hēs anebēn eis Ierousalēm proskynēsōn
verses.literal: You can verify {for yourself} that no - - more than twelve days ago . . . I went up to Jerusalem to worship

verses.original: καὶ εὗρόν με διαλεγόμενον πρός τινα οὔτε ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οὔτε ἢ ποιοῦντα ἐπίστασιν ὄχλου ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς οὔτε κατὰ τὴν πόλιν
verses.transliteration: kai heuron me dialegomenon pros tina oute en tō hierō oute ē poiounta epistasin ochlou en tais synagōgais oute kata tēn polin
verses.literal: Yet [my accusers] did not find me debating with anyone - in the temple - or riling up . . . a crowd in the synagogues [or] in the city

verses.original: οὐδὲ δύνανταί παραστῆσαι σοι περὶ ὧν νυνὶ κατηγοροῦσίν μου
verses.transliteration: oude dynantai parastēsai soi peri hōn nyni katēgorousin mou
verses.literal: Nor can they prove to you [any of] vvv vvv their charges against me

verses.original: Ὁμολογῶ τοῦτό σοι δὲ ὅτι οὕτως λατρεύω τῷ Θεῷ πατρῴῳ κατὰ τὴν Ὁδὸν ἣν λέγουσιν αἵρεσιν πιστεύων πᾶσι τοῖς κατὰ τὸν νόμον καὶ τοῖς γεγραμμένοις ἐν τοῖς προφήταις
verses.transliteration: Homologō touto soi de hoti houtōs latreuō tō Theō patrōō kata tēn Hodon hēn legousin hairesin pisteuōn pasi tois kata ton nomon kai tois gegrammenois en tois prophētais
verses.literal: I do confess - to you however that - I worship the God of our fathers according to the Way which they call a sect I believe everything that is laid down by the Law and - written in the Prophets

verses.original: ἔχων καὶ ἐλπίδα εἰς τὸν Θεόν ἣν αὐτοὶ οὗτοι προσδέχονται μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι ἀνάστασιν τε δικαίων καὶ ἀδίκων
verses.transliteration: echōn kai elpida eis ton Theon hēn autoi houtoi prosdechontai mellein esesthai anastasin te dikaiōn kai adikōn
verses.literal: [and] I have [the same] hope in - God that they themselves cherish [that] there will be a resurrection of both [the] righteous and [the] wicked

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ καὶ αὐτὸς ἀσκῶ διὰ παντός ἔχειν ἀπρόσκοπον συνείδησιν πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν καὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους
verses.transliteration: en toutō kai autos askō dia pantos echein aproskopon syneidēsin pros ton Theon kai tous anthrōpous
verses.literal: In this [hope] vvv I strive always . . . to maintain a clear conscience before - God and - man

verses.original: Δι’ πλειόνων ἐτῶν δὲ παρεγενόμην ποιήσων ἐλεημοσύνας εἰς μου τὸ ἔθνος καὶ προσφοράς
verses.transliteration: Di’ pleionōn etōn de paregenomēn poiēsōn eleēmosynas eis mou to ethnos kai prosphoras
verses.literal: After several years then I returned [ to Jerusalem ] to bring alms to my - people and to present offerings

verses.original: ἐν αἷς εὗρόν με ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἡγνισμένον οὐ μετὰ ὄχλου οὐδὲ μετὰ θορύβου δὲ τινὲς Ἰουδαῖοι ἀπὸ τῆς Ἀσίας
verses.transliteration: en hais heuron me en tō hierō hēgnismenon ou meta ochlou oude meta thorybou de tines Ioudaioi apo tēs Asias
verses.literal: At the time they found me in the temple I was ceremonially clean vvv [and] was not {inciting} [a] crowd [or] vvv an uproar But [there are] some Jews from - [the province of] Asia

verses.original: οὓς ἔδει παρεῖναι ἐπὶ σοῦ καὶ κατηγορεῖν εἴ ἔχοιεν τι πρὸς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: hous edei pareinai epi sou kai katēgorein ei echoien ti pros eme
verses.literal: who ought to appear before you and bring charges if they have anything against me

verses.original: ἢ οὗτοι εἰπάτωσαν αὐτοὶ τί ἀδίκημα εὗρον μου στάντος ἐπὶ τοῦ συνεδρίου
verses.transliteration: ē houtoi eipatōsan autoi ti adikēma heuron mou stantos epi tou synedriou
verses.literal: Otherwise . . . let [these men] state for themselves any crime they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin

verses.original: ἢ περὶ ταύτης μιᾶς φωνῆς ἧς ἐκέκραξα ἑστὼς ἐν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Περὶ ἀναστάσεως νεκρῶν ἐγὼ κρίνομαι ἐφ’ ὑμῶν σήμερον
verses.transliteration: ē peri tautēs mias phōnēs hēs ekekraxa hestōs en autois hoti Peri anastaseōs nekrōn egō krinomai eph’ hymōn sēmeron
verses.literal: unless [it was] . . . this one - thing I called out as I stood in their [presence] - [It is] concerning [the] resurrection of [the] dead [that] I am on trial before you today

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Φῆλιξ ἀκριβέστερον εἰδὼς τὰ περὶ τῆς Ὁδοῦ Ἀνεβάλετο αὐτοὺς εἴπας Ὅταν Λυσίας ὁ χιλίαρχος καταβῇ διαγνώσομαι τὰ καθ’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de ho Phēlix akribesteron eidōs ta peri tēs Hodou Anebaleto autous eipas Hotan Lysias ho chiliarchos katabē diagnōsomai ta kath’ hymas
verses.literal: Then - Felix vvv who was well informed - about the Way adjourned the hearing . . . [and] said When Lysias the commander comes I will decide vvv vvv your case

verses.original: διαταξάμενος τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ τηρεῖσθαι αὐτὸν τε ἔχειν ἄνεσιν καὶ μηδένα κωλύειν αὐτοῦ τῶν ἰδίων ὑπηρετεῖν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: diataxamenos tō hekatontarchē tēreisthai auton te echein anesin kai mēdena kōlyein autou tōn idiōn hypēretein autō
verses.literal: He ordered the centurion to keep [Paul] under guard . . . [but] to allow him some freedom and vvv permit his - [friends] to minister to his [needs]

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ τινὰς ἡμέρας ὁ Φῆλιξ παραγενόμενος σὺν ἰδίᾳ τῇ γυναικὶ Δρουσίλλῃ οὔσῃ Ἰουδαίᾳ μετεπέμψατο τὸν Παῦλον καὶ ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ περὶ τῆς πίστεως εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Meta de tinas hēmeras ho Phēlix paragenomenos syn idia tē gynaiki Drousillē ousē Ioudaia metepempsato ton Paulon kai ēkousen autou peri tēs pisteōs eis Christon Iēsoun
verses.literal: After vvv several days - Felix returned with [his] - wife Drusilla who was a Jewess He sent for - Paul and listened to him [speak] about - faith in Christ Jesus

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ διαλεγομένου περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ ἐγκρατείας καὶ τοῦ τοῦ μέλλοντος κρίματος ὁ Φῆλιξ γενόμενος ἔμφοβος ἀπεκρίθη πορεύου ἔχον Τὸ νῦν δὲ μεταλαβὼν καιρὸν μετακαλέσομαί σε
verses.transliteration: de autou dialegomenou peri dikaiosynēs kai enkrateias kai tou tou mellontos krimatos ho Phēlix genomenos emphobos apekrithē poreuou echon To nyn de metalabōn kairon metakalesomai se
verses.literal: [As] [Paul] expounded on righteousness - self-control and the - coming judgment - Felix became frightened [and] said You may go . . . for now [When] I find the time I will call for you

verses.original: ἅμα καὶ ἐλπίζων ὅτι ὑπὸ τοῦ Παύλου δοθήσεται αὐτῷ χρήματα διὸ καὶ μεταπεμπόμενος αὐτὸν πυκνότερον ὡμίλει αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: hama kai elpizōn hoti hypo tou Paulou dothēsetai autō chrēmata dio kai metapempomenos auton pyknoteron hōmilei autō
verses.literal: At the same time . . . he was hoping that - - Paul would offer him a bribe So - he sent for [Paul] frequently [and] talked with him

verses.original: δὲ Διετίας πληρωθείσης ὁ Φῆλιξ ἔλαβεν διάδοχον Πόρκιον Φῆστον τε θέλων καταθέσθαι χάριτα τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὁ Φῆλιξ κατέλιπε τὸν Παῦλον δεδεμένον
verses.transliteration: de Dietias plērōtheisēs ho Phēlix elaben diadochon Porkion Phēston te thelōn katathesthai charita tois Ioudaiois ho Phēlix katelipe ton Paulon dedemenon
verses.literal: [After] two years had passed - Felix vvv was succeeded by Porcius Festus And wishing to do the Jews a favor . . . . . . . . . - Felix left - Paul in prison
